tldr: This is a research-theme thread, not one event: 22 items, mostly arXiv preprints, from Nov 9 to Nov 25 on visual agents, multimodal benchmarks and hallucination fixes. Mid-month the work shifted from new benchmarks (WebArena-Pro, MM-ReportBench, Google's Multimodal Knowledge Agent Benchmark) to agents that fetch visual evidence with tools.
whats_new: A Nov 25 study found that adding a generated helper image to visual QA lowered mean accuracy by 3.7 points across 13 model pairs, while EVA the same day cut hallucinations by checking answers against tool-gathered visual evidence.
why_it_matters: For multimodal agents, the reliable gains in this thread come from grounding answers in fetched or re-read visual evidence; generating extra images or always sending pixels adds cost without a proven accuracy gain.

status.detail: Preprints only, no shipped products: evidence-seeking visual agents are the common direction, and one negative result questions image generation as a reasoning aid.

beats.headline: Kernel-optimization benchmarks for coding agents, clustered in by wording
beats.summary: Three papers on GPU, Ascend NPU and Arm CPU kernel tuning share vocabulary with this thread but are not about vision.

beats.headline: New benchmarks test multimodal agents on web, reports and long-horizon visual tasks
Agents zoom, search and build tools to gather visual evidence
beats.summary: Instead of reasoning over one image in context, these agents call tools to crop, search or remember visual state.

beats.headline: Training and decoding fixes target visually ungrounded answers
Industry papers use vision where it pays: cover photos, UX diagnostics, on-demand routing
Evidence-checking helps; generated helper images hurt

open_questions: Does any lab ship a production visual agent that verifies answers against tool-gathered evidence, as EVA does?
Does the 3.7-point accuracy drop from generated helper images hold for frontier models outside the 13 tested pairs?
Will WebArena-Pro or Google's Multimodal Knowledge Agent Benchmark get adopted as a standard leaderboard?
Do text-only routers like PreVIR cut visual-token cost in agent workloads, not only in translation?
take_for_builders: Before adding image generation or always-on image inputs to a multimodal agent, run an ablation on your own eval set; prefer zoom, crop and re-check tools that tie each answer to visual evidence.
